svg.aria-label: SmartDuck: An IoT Web-Based Balut and Penoy Production Monitoring and Egg Incubation System for Uno Duck Farm. A candling lamp passes under five duck eggs, showing which are balut and which are penoy, while the temperature, humidity and egg rolling are monitored live.
